$comment: Generated from the Factory file parser and the catalogues its apply path validates against. Edit logic/factoryfile/schema, then regenerate; a hand edit is reverted by the drift test.
title: agents/<name>/agent.md or workers/<name>/worker.md (also workers/<name>/agent.md; do not combine roots) frontmatter (v1alpha1)
description: YAML frontmatter of a worker file. The worker's name comes from its directory, never from a field. The Markdown body after the closing fence is the worker's prompt.

agentType.description: Deprecated alias of workerRole. Set only one of the two.

spawnableBy.description: Factory workers allowed to spawn this worker, named by their directory names. Omit to allow only the Factory foreman. An empty list allows no Factory worker. A non-empty list is the exact allowlist, so include the foreman explicitly to retain its access. Not valid when factory.yaml declares a blueprint, which derives every worker's allowlist itself.

hooks.description: Agent hook directories this Agent's runs load, before the hooks in factory.yaml. Replaces hooks inherited from agentDefaults or workerDefaults; an explicit empty list clears those defaults. Hooks in factory.yaml are still added and cannot be removed. Hooks run only on the Warp Agent harness. Not yet available on every deployment.
